evidence_scope.law_claim: Observed sample equality/inequality does not prove equality/inequality of every underlying distribution.
evidence_scope.normalization: Recorded float32 mean/std applied algebraically in NumPy; no claim of GPU bitwise arithmetic reproduction.
evidence_scope.protected_roles: All archive members decoded for exact content hashing; code2/code3 transition values excluded from numerical comparisons and no evaluation labels used.
evidence_scope.roles_compared: code0 fitting; exactly128 selected code1 calibration episodes; fitting-only normalization/probe/scale streams

heldout.interpretation: Observed prefix association, not a counterfactual dynamics replay. Consequences of earlier removed transitions remain in later retained states; removed transition tuples remain excluded. This is not evaluation-label leakage.
